stem.en: Why are ceramics excellent under compression but unreliable under tension?
stem.et: Miks on keraamika suurepärane survele, kuid ebausaldusväärne tõmbele?

label.en: Their rigid bonds resist compression but cannot deform to blunt a crack, so flaws propagate
label.et: Nende jäigad sidemed peavad survele vastu, kuid ei suuda deformeerudes pragu nürida, mistõttu defektid levivad

label.en: They are simply weak materials and cannot bear large loads at all
label.et: Need on lihtsalt nõrgad materjalid ega talu üldse suuri koormusi

label.en: Their properties are the average of their constituent phases
They behave like polymers, which are soft by nature
label.et: Need käituvad nagu polümeerid, mis on oma olemuselt pehmed
